text:
deploy-bot: starting v2 alpha slice at 11:02 UTC. ramp 4% -> 10% over 15m. note: header-case normalization + streaming reassembly enabled.
ana: flagged one customer 'beacon' on preflight that uses uppercase headers and a proxy that rewrites content-type. possible mismatch.
josh: staging repro for beacon: partial responses on long streams, ~0.9% 5xx at 11:06 UTC.
ops-lee: monitor auto-paused slice 2 at 11:07 UTC. revert applied to v1 for that slice.
emma: recommend pinning beacon to v1 until SDK patch lands. run pin API (ops token required).
ana: pin cmd:
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" -d '{"tenant":"beacon","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 stream partial responses","expires":"2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```
ops-lee: pin confirmed; deploy-bot acknowledged in 24s. telemetry backfill shows beacon 5xx down to 0.02% after 2m.
josh: we'll cut a minimal hotfix for stream delimiter handling; avoid touching header normalization unless we see broader breakage.
emma: release-notes action: add short blurb under Compat -> "Header names are now normalized in v2; if clients use proxies that mutate headers, pin to v1 and upgrade client SDK when patch available." include pin instructions.
deploy-bot: canary resumed for unaffected slices. keep monitoring for 30m.
ops-lee: adding incident INC-2026-498 and assigning to oncall. follow-up: tenant outreach and SDK patch ETA.
nana: thanks — will coordinate with SDK and tenant success.
